title: Count Inversion Pairs
body:
Count the pairs i < j with a_i > a_j. The interviewer asked for brute force first and then the O(n log n) divide-and-conquer version, so the large tests need the fast one.

Function to complete

Complete countInversions(a). It returns the number of inversion pairs.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.

py.pre:
from typing import *
import sys, math, collections, heapq, bisect, itertools, functools
from collections import *
py.post:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    _raw = sys.stdin.read(); _t = _raw.split(); _p = 0
    _n = int(_t[_p]); _p += 1
    a = list(map(int, _t[_p:_p + (_n)])); _p += (_n)
    _r = Solution().countInversions(a)
    print(_r)
